title: Construct exact cycle-preserving stationary approximants
statement: Decompose fixed positive complex circulation a_r=sum_(C contains r)m_C. For translated cycle u+w+y_j, each nominal edge has constant flux J_Cwu=(c m_C/Z_Gamma)lambda^(u+w)/(w!u!). Retain COMPLETE translated cycles wholly inside Gamma intersect{|x|1<=B}; the x0 communicating component Gamma_B_circle has exact normalized factorial law pi_B proportional lambda^x/x!. These components increase and exhaust the actual class, and every fixed original channel intensity is recovered for all sufficiently large B. Multiplying all contributions of a labelled channel by the same fixed relative-error factor gives pointwise convergent perturbed finite generators. IF their stationary laws have UNIFORM sufficiently high polynomial-W moments, tightness, finite-support stationary equations and finite stationary activity give an invariant limit, nonexplosion and positive recurrence on the actual irreducible class. Moments must pay the FULL augmented reaction degree/activity, not only original degree. The required uniform moments and perturbed transients remain conditions; these approximants are proof devices, not physical truncation.
